description: Wait for inbox messages up to timeout_seconds and return them. Use this only when this session's delivery instructions call for waiting. The wait can also end for a held-message notice or cancellation. Review a snapshot's supplied content; its file label is not a local path. Reply with review_request_id, based_on set to its sha256, and reply_to when available. Before using a local checkout, run `'/usr/local/bin/node' '/scratch/pkg/node_modules/hoptell/bin/hoptell.js' snapshot --check <received-sha256> <local-file>` and report match, mismatch or unable to check. On mismatch or failure, review the supplied content; local tests do not validate it. A review set (hoptell_review_set) lists files by file_id. Use its content only if hoptell's Review set check after the matching end marker says every file's content matches its sha256. The sender's user reviews and applies proposals; do not claim one was applied.

ack.description: Optional. The receipt returned with a message batch you have finished handling.

timeout_seconds.description: Maximum server wait in seconds (default 300, maximum 1500); the client may time out sooner.

name: wait_for_message
